raw_text: Situation in Manipur deteriorating by the hour. Verified videos show: 1) Multiple houses burning in Churachandpur (geolocated via Google Earth). 2) Armed groups on roads near Kangpokpi. 3) Displaced families gathering at community halls. 4) What appears to be police standing by without intervening. Sources on ground saying violence is ethnic — Meitei vs Kuki — triggered by ST status demand. State government has called Army but deployment unclear. This is the worst ethnic violence in Manipur in decades. Internet services reportedly being disrupted.
